Name: Nicanor
Summary: Nicanor was one of the seven men chosen to serve tables in the Jerusalem church. Acts names him among the seven and records nothing further of him by name.
KeyStory: Nicanor was chosen with the seven to see that no widow was neglected in the daily ministration.
LifeLesson: Faithful service needs no further story. Nicanor's one verse holds a whole ministry of fairness.
